name: Marketplace Dogfood MCP
description: A test plugin for dogfooding: one MCP server with two run modes and every kind of plugin variable. The server is the public MCP echo/everything example and holds no data.

api_token.label: API token
api_token.helpText: Any non-empty string: the echo server does not check it.

optional_token.label: Optional token
optional_token.helpText: Taken from DOGFOOD_OPTIONAL_TOKEN when set; otherwise asked, may be left empty.
